summary: B100: all14 contact and5native images viewed. No broad facial collapse; no convincing native collar-structure advantage versus A100 yet. Calibration neck patch and030 pitting persist. Three new held-outs retain ordinary clothing. This is an interim comparison, not a verdict on B300 or the full factorial.
limits: Small fixed panel. Contact-level coherence does not establish native photographic quality, identity preservation or distributional diversity. Held-out cases remain excluded from training.
